activation.note: The path and task-term facts are discovery cues qualified by their notes; the firing examples cover registry changes, newly typed and re-identified trains, and existing violations at CONFIRM. The exclusion preserves CONFIRM-wide validation. Observability labels acknowledge missing change/phase observers and distinguish mechanical checks from semantic naming judgment in the finding note.

audit.summary: All 24 segments survive at claimed destinations. Registration is the single then obligation, while mandatory naming and uniqueness remain explicit coder-facing prohibitions; additions are declared, no waivers are introduced, and no content is delegated to shared nodes.

segmentChecks.note: The combined statement is fully retained: registration-before-typing is mandatory in then/avoid[0], durable-noun naming in avoid[1], and both uniqueness constraints in avoid[2] and avoid[3].
Kebab-case, noun-led, durable-object naming and every excluded category are explicit and mandatory in avoid[1], not weakened by the positive wording in prefer[1].
The exact registry path, train identity form, and requirement that registration precede typing are preserved in then and reinforced operationally by prefer[0].
Registry uniqueness by subject and typed-train uniqueness by subject+slug are separately and unambiguously prohibited from violation.
CONFIRM is present in when and activation, including whole-registry validation of pre-existing violations.
Confirm-blocking enforcement is retained verbatim in verifier_detail[1] and explained in the activation phase note.

risks: Borderline durable-object versus theme/category names still require semantic judgment, but the rewrite supplies the complete decision criteria and exclusions rather than omitting a step.

unobservable: change: detecting newly typed or re-identified trains and registry-entry edits requires a new diff-level observer
phase: CONFIRM requires a new phase observer
finding: classifying a name as a noun-led durable object rather than a verb, actor, theme, route, category, owner, or program name is LLM-judged

review.summary: The rewrite preserves all three source invariants as mandatory planner-facing behavior and retains the CONFIRM blocking validation details. A weak planner can follow the required ordering, naming, and uniqueness decisions; activation is not currently fully deterministic only because the declared change/phase observers and semantic naming judgment are unavailable to Datalog.
